'''Penghu''' is the capital of the [[Democratic Republic of Suzuharu]] in the extracted source material.

The Suzuharu source describes Penghu as the country's cultural hub and third largest city. No dedicated city article has been found in the current checkout, so this bridge page preserves only that source role.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not assign Penghu a founding date, population, district layout, battle history, or exact map position until stronger source material is reviewed.
